# src/Connector.Core/Domain

Layer **domain** · project `Connector.Core`

Project navigation: [Connector.Core](../projects/Connector-Core-67ea6c7c243a.md)

## Overview 🤖

Contains domain models and utilities for export and import operations.

**Responsibilities.** Defines data structures and logic for managing export and import processes, including signatures for data integrity.

**Usage.** Used by API endpoints and infrastructure modules to handle export and import operations.

### ImportManifest

_record_ · [ImportManifest.cs](../../src/Connector.Core/Domain/ImportManifest.cs#L11)

Accompanies every inbound vendor file — the reverse-direction counterpart to `ExportManifest`, mirroring `FileSystemExportSink`'s outbound contract. No SequenceNumber: vendor confirmations don't arrive 1:1 per export run, so gap detection doesn't apply — the SHA-256 checksum alone covers file integrity. Which saved ImportDefinition a file targets is carried inside the data file's own ImportEnvelope (its definition field), not here — the manifest's only job is integrity.

_Linked tests:_ `ManifestSigningPolicyTests.NonEnforcingReceiver_AllowsUnknownProducerEvenWithSignature`, `ManifestSigningPolicyTests.OutboundSign_UsesEncryptedSettingAndCanBeVerifiedByReceivingPeer`, `ManifestSigningPolicyTests.Policy_RejectsUnknownProducerAndUnsignedPairedImport_ButAllowsVendor`, `ManifestSigningPolicyTests.TrustedPeer_RejectsMissingInvalidOrChangedSignature`, `ManifestSigningPolicyTests.TrustedReceiver_AlwaysRejectsInvalidSignatureEvenWithoutStrictMode`, `ManifestSigningPolicyTests.UnconfiguredReceiver_AllowsSignedFileFromUnknownProducer` — test code that uses it, not coverage
